[fa:salute,fam:known,theirs,warmly] {TO}, it is good to see your name on a letter again,
[fa:salute,fam:known,theirs,warm|cordial] Dear {TO}, once more,
[fa:salute,fam:known,theirs,cordial] To {TO} of {COLONY}, greetings again,
[fa:salute,fam:known,theirs,cordial|cool] To {TOFULL}, in answer,

[fa:salute,fam:known,theirs,cordial,w:spacer] {TO}, {COLONY}. Good to hear from you again.
[fa:salute,fam:known,theirs,cordial,m:trade] {TO}, my correspondent and, I hope, my customer,
[fa:salute,fam:familiar,theirs,warmly] {TO}, my friend,

[fa:salute,fam:familiar,theirs,warmly] {TO}, my dear correspondent,

[fa:salute,fam:familiar,theirs,warmly] Dear {TONICK}, if you will let me call you that,
[fa:salute,fam:familiar,theirs,warm|cordial] {TO}, as ever,
[fa:salute,fam:familiar,theirs,cordial] {TO}, here we are again,
[fa:salute,fam:familiar,theirs,cordial] {TO}, the usual greetings from {TOWN},

[fa:salute,fam:familiar,theirs,cordial|cool] {TO},
[fa:salute,fam:familiar,theirs,warm|cordial,w:tribal] {TO}, friend of our fire,
[fa:salute,fam:familiar,theirs,warm|cordial,w:tribal] {TO}, whose words the children now ask for by name,
[fa:salute,fam:familiar,theirs,cordial,w:spacer] {TO}. Channel open, as usual.
[fa:salute,fam:familiar,theirs,cordial,w:industrial] {TO}, same desk, same pen, same greeting,
[fa:salute,fam:familiar,theirs,cordial,m:trade] {TO}, my favourite customer by post,
[fa:salute,fam:familiar,theirs,cordial,m:duty] {TO}, greetings, as the office sends them, and mine besides,
[fa:salute,fam:familiar,theirs,a:empire,warm|cordial] Good {TO}, with the Empire's greeting and my own,

[fa:salute,fam:close,theirs,warm|cordial] {TO}, old friend,
[fa:salute,fam:close,theirs,cordial] {TO}, as always,
[fa:salute,fam:close,theirs,cordial] {TO}, my faithful correspondent,
[fa:salute,fam:close,theirs,warmly,w:tribal] {TO}, who has a place at our fire whether you come to it or not,
[fa:salute,fam:close,theirs,warmly,w:tribal] {TONICK}, friend of the long road,
[fa:salute,fam:close,theirs,warmly,w:spacer] {TONICK}. Hi. You know the rest.
[fa:salute,fam:close,theirs,warmly,w:industrial] {TO}, old pal,

[fa:salute,fam:close,theirs,warmly,their:scholars] {TO}, most cited of my correspondents,
[fa:salute,fam:close,theirs,warmly,their:crew] {TO}, my friend at the far end of the post road, fair winds,

[fa:salute,fam:cooled,theirs,cool] {TOFULL}, as I must,

[fa:salute,fam:cooled,theirs,cordial] {TOFULL}, greetings,
[fa:salute,fam:cooled,theirs,warm|cordial] {TO}, though that name is harder to write than it was,
[fa:salute,fam:cooled,theirs,a:war] {TOFULL}, across a war I did not want,
[fa:salute,fam:cooled,theirs,a:war] To {COLONY}, from the other side,
[fa:salute,fam:cooled,theirs,w:tribal] {TOFULL}. The fire is lower than it was.
[fa:salute,fam:cooled,theirs,w:spacer] {TOFULL}, {COLONY}. Formal channel.
[fa:open,fam:new,theirs,warm|cordial] I do not believe we have written to each other before, so let me say who I am: {FROM}, of {TOWN}, and glad to make your acquaintance by letter.
[fa:open,fam:new,theirs,warm|cordial] This is the first letter I have written to {COLONY}, though the name has come up at our table more than once.
[fa:open,fam:new,theirs,cordial] We have not written to one another before, so forgive me if I am formal. I would rather be too formal with a stranger than too familiar.
[fa:open,fam:new,theirs,cordial|cool] This is our first letter, so I will try to be clear, since neither of us knows yet how the other reads.
[fa:open,fam:new,theirs,cool] We do not know each other, so I will keep to the matter at hand.
[fa:open,fam:new,theirs,cool|curt] I do not know you, and you do not know me. That may change. For now, this.
[fa:open,fam:new,theirs,warm|cordial,w:tribal] I am {FROM}, of {TOWN}, and these words go to you for the first time. Hear them kindly.
[fa:open,fam:new,theirs,cordial,w:spacer] First letter between us, so for the record: I am {FROM}, I speak for myself unless I say otherwise, and I answer my post.
[fa:open,fam:new,theirs,cordial,w:industrial] I have not written to {COLONY} before. I had to ask at the post how it was spelled.
[fa:open,fam:new,theirs,cordial,m:trade] A first letter is a first handshake, in my trade, so here is my hand: {FROM}, of {TOWN}, always open to an honest offer.
[fa:open,fam:new,theirs,cordial|cool,m:wary] I will be honest. I do not know {COLONY}, and I am careful with people I do not know. This letter is me being careful.
[fa:open,fam:new,theirs,cordial|cool,m:proud] You will know {TOWN} by name, I expect. I write to {COLONY} now for the first time, and I do not write to just anyone.
[fa:open,fam:new,theirs,cordial|cool,m:duty] As this is the first letter between us under my hand, I set down who I am: {FROM}, who answers the town's letters.
[fa:open,fam:known,theirs,warmly] Another letter from {COLONY}. I was hoping there would be.
[fa:open,fam:known,theirs,warmly] I know your hand now. It is a small thing, but I noticed it on the bag before I opened it.
[fa:open,fam:known,theirs,warm|cordial] Your letters are becoming a habit at {TOWN}, and not a bad one.
[fa:open,fam:known,theirs,cordial] We have written a few times now, so I will not waste ink on introductions.
[fa:open,fam:known,theirs,cordial] Your letter came, and I answer it, as we seem to be in the way of doing.
[fa:open,fam:known,theirs,cordial|cool] I have your letter. You know by now that I answer them, if not always quickly.
[fa:open,fam:known,theirs,cool] Your letter came. I answer, as before.
[fa:open,fam:known,theirs,warm|cordial,w:tribal] Your words came to our fire again, and this time the old ones knew whose they were.
[fa:open,fam:known,theirs,cordial,w:spacer] Your message is in. We are starting to be regular correspondents, which on this world counts for something.
[fa:open,fam:known,theirs,cordial,m:trade] A correspondent who writes back is a good sign in my trade. A customer who comes back is a better one. I mention it.
[fa:open,fam:familiar,theirs,warmly] Your letter came, and I knew the hand before I broke the seal.
[fa:open,fam:familiar,theirs,warmly] I keep your letters in a drawer now. It is getting full, and I have no plans to empty it.
[fa:open,fam:familiar,theirs,warmly] I read your letter at the table, and someone asked who I was smiling at. I said nobody. They knew.
[fa:open,fam:familiar,theirs,warmly] The carrier said there was a letter from {COLONY}, and the whole house knew who it was for before I did.
[fa:open,fam:familiar,theirs,warm|cordial] Here we are again, you and I and a sheet of paper.
[fa:open,fam:familiar,theirs,cordial] Your letter came, as they do, and here is mine back, as it does.
[fa:open,fam:familiar,theirs,cordial] I have stopped counting our letters. Somewhere past the first handful it began to seem rude.
[fa:open,fam:familiar,theirs,cordial|cool] Your letter, my answer. We have the way of it by now.
[fa:open,fam:familiar,theirs,cordial,m:trade] You are the only customer I write to who sends news instead of complaints. It is refreshing, and I have told the others.
[fa:open,fam:familiar,theirs,cordial,m:duty] Your letters come straight to my desk now. The clerks have given up sorting them.
[fa:open,fam:familiar,theirs,warmly,w:tribal] The runner did not need to say whose words these were. The children were already shouting the name of {COLONY}.
[fa:open,fam:familiar,theirs,cordial,w:spacer] Your message flagged itself. I set it to, a while ago. Do not tell anyone.
[fa:open,fam:familiar,theirs,cordial,w:industrial] The post comes on the same day every week, and on that day I find myself at the window.
[fa:open,fam:close,theirs,warmly] I read your letter standing in the doorway, then again sitting down, which is how I know it was a good one.
[fa:open,fam:close,theirs,warmly] I had been waiting for your letter without admitting it to anyone, least of all myself.
[fa:open,fam:close,theirs,warmly] There is a chair by the window where I read your letters. It has become your chair. Nobody else sits in it.
[fa:open,fam:close,theirs,warmly] I have so much to tell you and no idea where to start, which is how I know we are old friends.
[fa:open,fam:close,theirs,warmly] Your letter came on a bad day and made it a better one. I do not think I have ever said that. I am saying it now.
[fa:open,fam:close,theirs,warmly] I know your letters well enough now to read them in your voice.
[fa:open,fam:close,theirs,warm|cordial] Old friend, I will skip the pleasantries. You know them already, and I mean them.
[fa:open,fam:close,theirs,cordial] We have been writing long enough that I no longer think about how to begin. I simply begin.
[fa:open,fam:close,theirs,warmly,w:tribal] When your words come, the old ones move over and make room for me nearest the fire to hear them. That is how it is with you now.
[fa:open,fam:close,theirs,warmly,w:spacer] Read your message twice and saved it to the good folder. Yes, I have a good folder. You are most of it.
[fa:open,fam:close,theirs,warmly,w:industrial] I have worn a groove in the path to the post box, and it is your fault.
[fa:open,fam:close,theirs,warmly,c:tea] I put the kettle on before I opened your letter. It has become a small ceremony, and you are the reason for it.
[fa:open,fam:close,theirs,warmly,c:coffee] I made a fresh pot before I opened your letter. Your letters deserve the good cup.
[fa:open,fam:cooled,theirs] Your letter came. I will answer it, as I answer all letters.
[fa:open,fam:cooled,theirs] I will not pretend things are as they were between us.
[fa:open,fam:cooled,theirs] I write because a letter deserves an answer, and for no other reason just now.
[fa:open,fam:cooled,theirs] There was a time I would have filled this page. That time is not now.
[fa:open,fam:cooled,theirs,cool|curt|refusal] I have your letter. I will be brief, and you will understand why.
[fa:open,fam:cooled,theirs,warm|cordial] I have thought a long while about how to write this, and decided to write it plainly.
[fa:open,fam:cooled,theirs,a:war] I never thought I would write to you across a war. I find I do not know how.
[fa:open,fam:cooled,theirs,a:war] Our peoples are at war, and the letters between us must pass under a white flag now. That says enough.
[fa:open,fam:cooled,theirs,w:tribal] The fire at {TOWN} burns lower for {COLONY} than it did. You know why, or you should.
[fa:open,fam:cooled,theirs,m:trade] I keep my accounts honestly, and I keep the one between us too. It is not in your favour this season.
[fa:open,fam:cooled,theirs,w:spacer] Message received. Logged. Answered. That is the procedure, and today I am following the procedure.
[fa:pen,pen:new,theirs,warmly|cordial,fam:known|fam:familiar|fam:close] I see the hand is {TO}'s this time. Give {LASTPEN} my regards; I had grown used to that handwriting.
[fa:pen,pen:new,theirs,warmly,fam:familiar|fam:close] A new hand from {COLONY}. Welcome, {TO}. Tell {LASTPEN} that I notice these things, and that I hope all is well.
[fa:pen,pen:new,theirs,cordial|cool,fam:known|fam:familiar|fam:close] I note that {TO} writes now, where {LASTPEN} wrote before. I answer whoever writes.
[fa:pen,pen:new,theirs,warmly,fam:close] So {TO} has the pen now. I will have to break you in, {TO}. {LASTPEN} took a year.
[fa:pen,pen:new,theirs,warmly|cordial,fam:familiar|fam:close,w:tribal] Your words come in a new voice. Tell {LASTPEN} the fire remembers.
[fa:pen,pen:new,theirs,cordial,fam:known|fam:familiar|fam:close,w:spacer] New sender on the channel. Hello, {TO}. Say hello to {LASTPEN} for me.
[fa:pen,pen:new,theirs,fam:cooled] I see {TO} writes now. I would sooner have heard from {LASTPEN}, but no matter.
[fa:long,fam:long,theirs,warmly|cordial,fam:known|fam:familiar|fam:close] It has been a long while since we wrote. I had begun to wonder whether the road had swallowed our letters.
[fa:long,fam:long,theirs,warmly,fam:familiar|fam:close] So much time has gone by since we last wrote that I had to think how we used to begin. Like this, I think.
[fa:long,fam:long,theirs,cordial|cool,fam:known|fam:familiar|fam:close] A long silence, and then your letter. I will not ask what kept you if you do not ask what kept me.
[fa:long,fam:long,theirs,warmly,fam:close] I had nearly stopped looking for your letters. Do not make me do that again.
[fa:long,fam:long,theirs,w:tribal,fam:known|fam:familiar|fam:close] Seasons have gone by since words last passed between our fires. We thought of you in them.
[fa:long,fam:long,theirs,fam:cooled] It has been some time. Perhaps that is as well.
[fa:close,fam:new,theirs,warm|cordial] In hope of a reply, and of more letters after it,
[fa:close,fam:new,theirs,cordial] With respect, and with good wishes from a stranger, for now,
[fa:close,fam:new,theirs,cordial|cool] Respectfully,
[fa:close,fam:new,theirs,cool|curt] Until we know each other better,
[fa:close,fam:new,theirs,warm|cordial,w:tribal] Go well, stranger. Perhaps not a stranger next time.
[fa:close,fam:new,theirs,cordial,w:spacer] End of first message. Hoping for a second.
[fa:close,fam:new,theirs,cordial,m:trade] In hope of business, and of a letter back,
[fa:close,fam:known,theirs,warmly] Write again soon. I have got used to it.
[fa:close,fam:known,theirs,warm|cordial] Until your next,
[fa:close,fam:known,theirs,cordial] Until the next letter,
[fa:close,fam:known,theirs,cool] Until the next, then,
[fa:close,fam:known,theirs,warm|cordial,w:tribal] Until your words come again,
[fa:close,fam:familiar,theirs,warmly] Yours, as always,
[fa:close,fam:familiar,theirs,warmly] Until next time, my friend,
[fa:close,fam:familiar,theirs,warmly] Your friend at {TOWN},
[fa:close,fam:familiar,theirs,warm|cordial] As ever,
[fa:close,fam:familiar,theirs,cordial] As always,
[fa:close,fam:familiar,theirs,cordial] Yours, as usual,
[fa:close,fam:familiar,theirs,cordial] The same as ever, and glad of it,
[fa:close,fam:familiar,theirs,cordial,m:trade] Yours in letters and in trade, as ever,
[fa:close,fam:familiar,theirs,cordial,m:duty] For {TOWN}, and for myself,
[fa:close,fam:familiar,theirs,warmly,w:tribal] Walk well, friend of the fire,
[fa:close,fam:familiar,theirs,cordial,w:spacer] Same time next cycle,
[fa:close,fam:close,theirs,warmly] Your old friend,
[fa:close,fam:close,theirs,warmly] Ever yours,
[fa:close,fam:close,theirs,warmly] With all the love the post allows,
[fa:close,fam:close,theirs,warmly] Until I can say all this across a table,
[fa:close,fam:close,theirs,warmly] Your friend, who misses your letters between letters,
[fa:close,fam:close,theirs,warmly] Write soon, or I shall write twice and embarrass us both,
[fa:close,fam:close,theirs,warm|cordial] Always,
[fa:close,fam:close,theirs,cordial] Your faithful correspondent,
[fa:close,fam:close,theirs,warmly,w:tribal] Your place by our fire is kept,
[fa:close,fam:close,theirs,warmly,w:spacer] Love from {TOWN}. Do not let it go to your head,
[fa:close,fam:close,theirs,warmly,w:industrial] Your pal, always,
[fa:close,fam:close,theirs,warmly,c:tea] Yours, with the kettle on for you,
[fa:close,fam:familiar,theirs,cool] As before,
[fa:salute,fam:close,theirs,cool] {TO},
[fa:open,fam:close,theirs,cool] We know each other too well by now for me to hide that I am out of sorts. I will be short today.
[fa:close,fam:close,theirs,cool] Yours, as ever, if a little short today,
[fa:close,fam:cooled,theirs] Regards,
[fa:close,fam:cooled,theirs] Sincerely,
[fa:close,fam:cooled,theirs] That is all for now.
[fa:close,fam:cooled,theirs,cool|curt|refusal] No more.
[fa:close,fam:cooled,theirs,warm|cordial] Yours, still, though it is harder to write,
[fa:close,fam:cooled,theirs,a:war] Until this war is over, if it ends,
[fa:close,fam:cooled,theirs,w:tribal] The fire will tell us if it is to burn higher again.
[fa:salute,fam:new,ours,warm|cordial] To {TOFULL} of {TOWN}, greetings from {COLONY},
[fa:salute,fam:new,ours,cordial] To {TOFULL} of {TOWN}, whom we have not had the pleasure of writing to before,
[fa:salute,fam:new,ours,cordial|cool] To {TOFULL} at {TOWN},
[fa:salute,fam:new,ours,cool|curt] {TOFULL},
[fa:salute,fam:new,ours,v:eloquent,warm|cordial] To {TOFULL} of {TOWN}, with the first greetings of {COLONY}, and we hope not the last,
[fa:salute,fam:new,ours,v:blunt] {TOFULL} of {TOWN},
[fa:salute,fam:new,ours,a:empire] To the honoured {TOFULL}, at {TOWN},
[fa:salute,fam:new,ours,a:war] To {TOFULL} of {TOWN}, under a white flag,
[fa:salute,fam:known,ours,warmly] Dear {TO}, and hello again,
[fa:salute,fam:known,ours,cordial] To {TO} at {TOWN}, greetings again from {COLONY},
[fa:salute,fam:known,ours,cool] To {TOFULL}, once more,
[fa:salute,fam:known,ours,v:blunt] {TO}, again,
[fa:salute,fam:known,ours,v:eloquent,warm|cordial] {TO}, it is a pleasure to be writing to {TOWN} again,
[fa:salute,fam:familiar,ours,warmly] {TO}, our friend at {TOWN},
[fa:salute,fam:familiar,ours,warmly] Dear {TO}, hello again from all of us,
[fa:salute,fam:familiar,ours,warmly] {TONICK},
[fa:salute,fam:familiar,ours,warm|cordial] {TO}, as ever,
[fa:salute,fam:familiar,ours,cordial] {TO}, the usual greetings from {COLONY},
[fa:salute,fam:familiar,ours,v:blunt] {TO},
[fa:salute,fam:familiar,ours,v:eloquent,warmly] {TO}, dear friend of {COLONY}, and of mine,
[fa:salute,fam:familiar,ours,v:cheerful,warmly] {TO}, hello, hello, it is us again,
[fa:salute,fam:close,ours,warmly] Dearest {TO},
[fa:salute,fam:close,ours,warmly] {TONICK},
[fa:salute,fam:close,ours,warmly] My dear old {TO},
[fa:salute,fam:close,ours,warmly] {TO}, friend of everyone here,
[fa:salute,fam:close,ours,warmly] Dear {TONICK}, our favourite person at {TOWN}, though do not tell the others,
[fa:salute,fam:close,ours,warm|cordial] {TO}, old friend,
[fa:salute,fam:close,ours,v:blunt,warmly] {TONICK}. You know who this is.
[fa:salute,fam:close,ours,v:eloquent,warmly] {TO}, dearest of correspondents and most patient of readers,
[fa:salute,fam:close,ours,v:gloomy,warmly] {TO}, the one bright thing in the post bag,
[fa:salute,fam:cooled,ours] {TOFULL},
[fa:salute,fam:cooled,ours] To {TOFULL} of {TOWN},
[fa:salute,fam:cooled,ours,cool|curt] To {TOWN},
[fa:salute,fam:cooled,ours,warm|cordial] {TO}, if we may still call you that,
[fa:salute,fam:cooled,ours,a:war] To {TOFULL}, across the war,
[fa:open,fam:new,ours,warm|cordial] We have not written to you before, so let me say who we are: {COLONY}, and I am {FROM}, who writes for it.
[fa:open,fam:new,ours,cordial] This is the first letter {COLONY} has sent you, as far as any of us know, so forgive us if it is a little stiff.
[fa:open,fam:new,ours,cordial|cool] We do not know each other yet. I will be plain, which seems the best way to begin.
[fa:open,fam:new,ours,v:blunt] I am {FROM}, of {COLONY}. We have not written before. Here is why I write now.
